research_type: existing-dossier keyword discovery and targeted textual triage

candidates.name: Chester the bearsaurus
candidates.observed_lead: Bear-like, antlered predator with massive hindquarters, small forelimbs and a partly reptilian head; climbs by leaping and dies during the hunt.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: Laboratory creation, age and ecological damage are Dilo's account. Use bearsaurus as the existing display form; preserve barosaurus as an ASR variant in notes. A name alone does not make this observed animal a reasoning NPC.
candidates.publication_basis: Synthesis of existing episode dossiers; no new transcript or audio review

candidates.name: Dunebreaker fruit ooze
candidates.observed_lead: Fruit-speckled gelatin escapes through drains and grows by absorbing waste, debris and bodies; steam breaks it apart and the final cherry-bearing globule is destroyed.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: Treat as one individual. Its growth explanation is retrospective GM confirmation; faint fiend-like detection does not identify it as a demon.
candidates.publication_basis: Synthesis of existing episode dossiers; no new transcript or audio review

candidates.name: Tainted displacer beast
candidates.observed_lead: Wounded, tentacled cat-like predator with deceptive shifting position and exposed brain tissue; killed in the Black Mine chasm.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: Describe the observed specimen and apparent displacer-beast identity; do not invent why it was altered or claim a sourced D&D deviation.
candidates.publication_basis: Synthesis of existing episode dossiers; no new transcript or audio review

candidates.name: Brain-backed spiders
candidates.observed_lead: Giant spider with exposed pulsing brain and smaller brain-marked swarms; poison and domination make the shaft encounter distinctive.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: The giant dies in E074. Separate large and small forms; Cerinthala's pouch does not by itself prove their origin, breeding or control mechanism.
candidates.publication_basis: Synthesis of existing episode dossiers; no new transcript or audio review

candidates.name: Skeleton-spawning flesh giant
candidates.observed_lead: Malformed flesh-and-bone body produces skeletons through shoulder cavities and fresh wounds; its death ends further spawning.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: Use a descriptive name. No official species, creator or claim that every skeleton at Kervalon came from it is established.
candidates.publication_basis: Synthesis of existing episode dossiers; no new transcript or audio review

candidates.name: Black puddings
candidates.observed_lead: Two corrosive cave masses split under slashing attacks and damage Hope's equipment.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: Nash supplies the identification. Keep demonstrated corrosion and splitting separate from the full rules list discussed at the table.
candidates.publication_basis: Synthesis of existing episode dossiers; no new transcript or audio review

candidates.name: Basilisk of the under-Pit caves
candidates.observed_lead: Eight-legged reptile with a petrifying gaze; its remains later contribute to restoring petrified companions.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: The beast dies in E045. Later preparation is not a second kill; do not backdate extraction of a finished cure to the earlier digestive-oil discussion.
candidates.publication_basis: Synthesis of existing episode dossiers; no new transcript or audio review

candidates.name: Luminous desert beetles
candidates.observed_lead: Large beetles with luminous fleshy appendages surround Fate 4 at night; travelers use noise and movement to avoid them.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: Exact dimensions, diet and eventual departure remain listening questions. Suitable for a short entry; no need to invent a species name.
candidates.publication_basis: Synthesis of existing episode dossiers; no new transcript or audio review

candidates.name: Stormland Tyrannosaurus
candidates.observed_lead: Huge predator crushes Fate 4, falls into a storm-drain pit and is killed; teeth and bones become tools and salvage.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: Keep this animal distinct from Polymorph forms of Vorel or Stanley. No cause for its enormous size or connection to the storm is established.
candidates.publication_basis: Synthesis of existing episode dossiers; no new transcript or audio review

candidates.name: Outlands wyverns
candidates.observed_lead: Flying predators ram the Traveler's Twin and attack with bites and venomous stings.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: Separate wyverns from the accompanying winged beastmen. One is turned into a falling rat with no witnessed final landing or reversion; do not resolve every individual's fate.
candidates.publication_basis: Synthesis of existing episode dossiers; no new transcript or audio review

candidates.name: Tentacled purple fungi
candidates.observed_lead: Large animate purple mushrooms grapple and strike in the Black Mine.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: Unidentified hostile fungi, not a confirmed named fungal species; harmless mushroom beds and later Elhandar fungi are separate.
candidates.publication_basis: Synthesis of existing episode dossiers; no new transcript or audio review

candidates.name: Lizardfolk riding raptors
candidates.observed_lead: Raptor-like animals serve hunters and carry the party during the escape from Razak Val; their hides are also used for repairs.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: Separate wild behavior, mounts, individual deaths and the raptor named Mawstorm from Vorel's similarly named sword. Exact species remains descriptive.
candidates.publication_basis: Synthesis of existing episode dossiers; no new transcript or audio review

candidates.name: Green-case mimic
candidates.observed_lead: Green military-case form with teeth and a grappling tongue; Stanley breaks the remaining hinge and kills it. The severed tongue is fed to the separate doglike animal.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: Death and anatomy are supported by selected dual-export passages. No complete stat block, acid power or universal internal-storage ability inferred.
candidates.discovery_observed_lead: A sealed green case becomes a tongue-bearing attacker in Leopold's facility.
candidates.discovery_boundary_or_next_check: Recheck its defeat and anatomy in targeted SRT windows before drafting; the accompanying doglike threat is a separate creature.
candidates.publication_basis: Selected E008 Parakeet windows with Qwen cross-reading of core findings, plus existing E009 dossier context; no full-episode or audio review

candidates.name: Doglike facility predator
candidates.observed_lead: Large doglike animal with eight legs; directly vanishes at the doorway and reappears on a table. It later eats the mimic tongue and remains alive in the lab.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: Teleportation is narrated, but species, origin and movement limits remain unknown. Feeding is not permanent taming; collapse does not establish death or escape.
candidates.discovery_observed_lead: Animal-like creature menaces the party during the mimic encounter and may teleport.
candidates.discovery_boundary_or_next_check: Do not name it a blink dog or phase creature on the current dossier alone, or import the unrelated E043 blink dog.
candidates.publication_basis: Selected E008 Parakeet windows with Qwen cross-reading of core findings, plus existing E009 dossier context; no full-episode or audio review

candidates.name: Gibbering mouther
candidates.observed_lead: Pink fleshy body with eyes and mouths, tooth-driven movement, sticky ground, distracting gibbering and blinding spit. Chance escapes attempted absorption; the creature dies after Eddie's arrow.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: No scientist origin, completed assimilation or permanent Chance death inferred. The post-hardening voice disagreement and Fire Bolt/Fireball wording are retained in the source report.
candidates.discovery_observed_lead: Named attacker during the attempted escape from Leopold's collapsing facility.
candidates.discovery_boundary_or_next_check: The dossier offers limited anatomy and final-fate detail. Keep separate from the E020 displacer beast; check targeted transcript passages.
candidates.publication_basis: Selected Parakeet windows with Qwen cross-reading of core findings; no full-episode or audio review

candidates.name: Concealing mushroom-pit spider
candidates.observed_lead: Gigantic ceiling-concealed spider becomes blue-green, blocks escape and is killed by Vorel's cutting attacks and fall; severed legs provide food.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: No fixed phase-spider species, interplanar mechanism, intrinsic spore power or witnessed mushroom diet established. Position wording and nearby bag ownership remain qualified.
candidates.discovery_observed_lead: Large partly hidden or invisible spider attacks amid luminous mushrooms; legs are harvested after its defeat.
candidates.discovery_boundary_or_next_check: Do not silently call it a phase spider, merge it with CHIDS brain-spiders or attribute the mushroom spores to the spider itself.
candidates.publication_basis: Selected Parakeet windows with Qwen cross-reading of core findings; no full-episode or audio review

candidates.name: Pale tentacled cavern organism
candidates.observed_lead: Pale wormlike animal gives territorial warning, lets the party retreat and burrows away. A later partly eaten-looking stone form resembles its kind.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: No fixed tentacle count, species, secretion source, diet, petrification cause or same-individual identity.
candidates.discovery_observed_lead: Long worm-like creature blends with pale wall strands; a later body of the apparent same kind is petrified.
candidates.discovery_boundary_or_next_check: A warning sound and retreat are observed, not a kill. Name, ecology and exact relation between the two specimens remain unknown.
candidates.publication_basis: Selected Parakeet windows with Qwen cross-reading of core findings; no full-episode or audio review

candidates.name: River headache creatures
candidates.observed_lead: Explicitly identified humanoid undead cause painful buzzing and gaze harm; speech is untranslated. The first kill is followed by more arrivals; the fought attackers are defeated and Vorel stabilized.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: Personhood remains unresolved. No mindlessness, named standard species, original identity, psychic-damage rule or global elimination inferred.
candidates.discovery_observed_lead: Dark humanoid river figures cause dread, headache and necrotic or psychic harm.
candidates.discovery_boundary_or_next_check: Utterances are untranslated and personhood is unresolved. Check reasoning/NPC fit before creating a bestiary article; do not assign a standard undead identity.
candidates.publication_basis: Selected Parakeet windows with Qwen cross-reading of core findings; no full-episode or audio review

candidates.name: Froghemoth gut inhabitants
candidates.observed_lead: Gut worms retain distinct stomach and intestinal observations. The filament hunter survives its line being severed; the first later roper dies and the second is left alive.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: No single species, light response, shared origin, confirmed toxin rule or universal death in host decay. The host mind and Eye of Groxl remain separate reasoning subjects.
candidates.discovery_observed_lead: Light-avoiding digestive organisms and larger thread-bearing or tentacled roper-like inhabitants occupy the interior.
candidates.discovery_boundary_or_next_check: Several descriptions may indicate different organisms. Reconcile the sequence and distinguish incidental digestive fauna from distinct subjects before naming pages.
candidates.publication_basis: Selected Parakeet windows with narrower Qwen cross-readings; no full-episode or audio review
candidates.publication_scope: Three subject pages; gut worms retain two distinct observed forms without a single-species identification.

candidates.name: Bloodsucking desert swarm
candidates.observed_lead: Approaching black bloodsucker cloud and mosquito-like sound; company and raptors shelter in Tiny Hut under a formed sand canopy.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: Diptak supplies feeding and infiltration warnings, not witnessed casualties. No precise population, species, hut breach, lethal sand effect or swarm destruction.
candidates.discovery_observed_lead: Vast dark swarm forces the travelers to shelter in Tiny Hut.
candidates.discovery_boundary_or_next_check: No confirmed species or individual morphology in the dossier; do not identify it as stirges, mosquitoes or another standard monster.
candidates.publication_basis: Selected Parakeet windows with narrower Qwen cross-readings; no full-episode or audio review

candidates.name: Parasitic headworms and related worm forms
candidates.observed_lead: Head-dwelling black worms, Razak Val skin-invading spray and Dolo Popio spawned/exhaled forms retain separate accounts; observed pursuit, attempted entry, removals and explosions are bounded by individual encounters.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: No single species, lifecycle, universal control, complete cure or extinction inferred. Whisper suggestion, private observations, captured bedding specimen, host speech and later offspring terminology remain qualified.
candidates.discovery_observed_lead: Observed head parasites, a captured bedchamber worm, an outbreak of host transformation and later explosive or exhaled worms.
candidates.discovery_boundary_or_next_check: This is a research cluster, not one established species. Separate host testimony, observed parasites, spawned forms and transmission hypotheses; Dolo Popio remains a reasoning antagonist.
candidates.publication_basis: Selected Parakeet windows with narrower Qwen cross-readings; no full-episode or audio review
candidates.publication_scope: Three subject pages without a proven common species or lifecycle; host identities and the reasoning antagonist remain separate.

candidates.name: Translucent psychic wall-passers
candidates.observed_lead: Small glowing tentacled creatures pass through walls, gather to songs, convey painless mental sensations, avoid Hope/Stanley and retreat at the toy squeak.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: No intelligible answers, moral test, confirmed mind control, brain consumption, standard species or lasting familiar established. Intelligence remains unresolved.
candidates.discovery_observed_lead: Glowing tentacled creatures pass through walls, respond to strong emotion and recoil from the squeaking plush toy.
candidates.discovery_boundary_or_next_check: Keep the toy separate from living creatures. Recheck agency and identification rather than inventing a standard species.
candidates.publication_basis: Selected Parakeet windows with narrower Qwen cross-readings; no full-episode or audio review

candidates.name: CHIDS hellhounds
candidates.observed_lead: Flaming black hounds breathe fire, resist Vorel fire, take frost and special radiant attacks, and all hounds in the encountered pack are killed by the E071 continuation.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: No exact initial pack size, general cold/radiant vulnerability, universal death explosion or imported stat block. Vorel fire-resistance adjudication is corrected; security apes remain separate.
candidates.discovery_observed_lead: Flaming hounds with fire breath attack inside the facility.
candidates.discovery_boundary_or_next_check: Review the continuing fight for last observed survivors and distinguish observed behavior from baseline rule assumptions.
candidates.publication_basis: Selected E070/E071 Parakeet windows with narrower Qwen cross-readings; no full-episode or audio review

candidates.name: Corpse-bearing ice constructs
candidates.observed_lead: Four corpse-bearing ice forms attack; one retreats, three released corpse attackers die, and Toby later speaks intelligibly about fearing Cerinthala would leave them.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: Named companions and a reasoning survivor do not establish a non-intelligent species. Multiple corpses, shells and named individuals lack a complete one-to-one mapping; no all-four destruction or later Toby survival claimed.
candidates.discovery_observed_lead: Four enormous animated ice bodies enclose preserved corpses and attack around the resting party.
candidates.discovery_boundary_or_next_check: No universal ice-golem identity or explanation for every enclosed person is established; not all four are confirmed destroyed in the continuation.
candidates.routing_basis: E073 Toby answers in intelligible speech with a personal motive and relationship; preserve named companions in character context rather than inventing a non-reasoning species.

candidates.name: Blue-black hooked-tail flyer
candidates.observed_lead: Blue-black leathery flyer has a thorned arrowhead tail and frightens Nash/Vorel; Eye supplies bright-light guidance. Hope kills the first; another loses its head at the portal while more remain above.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: No named species, tail venom, sleep immunity, fixed radiant vulnerability, general portal kill rule or identity with Lethanphius. Residual biting of the severed head is not established lasting life.
candidates.discovery_observed_lead: Leathery winged attacker with a hooked tail causes fear and is killed by Hope.
candidates.discovery_boundary_or_next_check: Species and origins remain unidentified. Do not merge with the speaking winged vessel occupant encountered in E077.
candidates.publication_basis: Selected E076 Parakeet windows with narrower Qwen cross-readings and existing E077 dossier identity context; no full-episode or audio review.

candidates.name: Wormfather party's winged stinging pet
candidates.observed_lead: Winged reptilian pet uses a poison sting, bites and claws; Stanley kills it with Booming Blade/Diplomacy. E058 recap explicitly calls it a wyvern.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: Wyvern label is recap evidence, not anatomical inference. No identity with the removed skyfall body, chasm flyer, Outlands individuals or Dolo Popio; no universal poison defense or innate death explosion.
candidates.discovery_observed_lead: Dragon-like winged pet fights alongside the crater attackers and is killed by Stanley.
candidates.discovery_boundary_or_next_check: Not the retrieved skyfall creature; no automatic wyvern classification or identity with E076's flyer.
candidates.publication_basis: Selected E057 played encounter and E058 retrospective recap in Parakeet/Qwen; no full-episode or audio review.

candidates.name: Six-limbed desert burrower
candidates.observed_lead: Immense gear-scaled creature falls through a rift and burrows into Earth as a violent sand front forms.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: Morphology and entry are witnessed; planetary conversion purpose is the Soulbroker's claim. Name, intelligence, origin and full mechanism remain unknown; no invented species or lethal outcome.

candidates.name: Pit froghemoth and altered upper form
candidates.observed_lead: Three-eyed pit predator and later enormous many-eyed form with an inhabitable digestive tract and separating upper cocoon.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: E053 contains private mental bargaining and the creature's claim of intended ascent. Resolve form/NPC routing, continuity of specimens and attribution first. The upper portion escapes; the entire organism is not confirmed dead.

candidates.name: Red memory-devouring organisms
candidates.observed_lead: Many-faced red mass makes tethered lookalikes and inflicts a persistent penalty; later red growths attack and burrow.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: Copies can appear to speak. Check agency and whether later red organisms are the same kind before treating this as one non-reasoning species.

candidates.name: Figgy-pudding ooze
candidates.observed_lead: Sugar-decorated hostile pudding appears in the laboratory Christmas test and is cut apart by Riley.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: Wastes-setting one-off with no supplied main-campaign calendar placement. Do not merge it with the E109 fruit ooze.

candidates.name: Undead reindeer and powered Rudolph
candidates.observed_lead: Mutilated undead flying deer and a separate battery-equipped red-nosed attacker threaten the test subjects.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: Keep the undead herd and powered individual distinct; Rudolph is destroyed. This is a constructed test environment, not evidence of a literal North Pole or a universal reindeer type.

candidates.name: Sand squid
candidates.observed_lead: Schooling desert animals that eat insects; tentacles, two eyes and bulbous head. Recurring food includes meat, dried rations and creamy juice added to coffee.
candidates.boundary_or_next_check: Owner-supplied follow-up with targeted transcript review; not full-episode or audio verification. Keep CHIDS pool organisms, Sigil lack of supply, unrelated shelter carcass and unconfirmed ooze ancestry separate.
